profile_text.body:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a publicly traded subsidiary of Amazon, founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, WA. Amazon reported revenue of $716,924,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker AMZN with SEC CIK 0001018724.

AWS offers two tracked AI products. Amazon SageMaker is described by the company as a unified development environment for data, analytics, and machine learning, covering the full ML lifecycle from training and model customization through deployment, monitoring, bias detection, and explainability. The platform includes SageMaker Unified Studio, which brings together tools for model development, generative AI, data processing, and SQL analytics in a single managed environment, and incorporates components such as HyperPod, JumpStart, MLOps tooling, and Amazon Q Developer, which the company describes as a generative AI assistant for software development. SageMaker also provides lakehouse capabilities unifying Amazon S3 data lakes and Amazon Redshift warehouses via an Apache Iceberg-compatible architecture, along with governance features including Amazon SageMaker Catalog for access control and tools for toxicity detection and responsible AI policy enforcement. AWS Bedrock is a separate managed service offering foundation model APIs with IAM integration, VPC support, model evaluation tools, and AgentCore for agent orchestration.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or patent filings are recorded in the held facts for Amazon Web Services at this time.
